api: IMAP4rev2 (RFC 9051) and SMTP submission (RFC 6409) wire protocols — not a REST API
scope: Native protocol surface only. IMAP LIST supplies mailbox records. SMTP MAIL/RCPT/DATA submits the one typed write action. SMTP has no list, fetch, or search command and is deliberately not declared as a read surface. Message polling is unavailable pending #3810; IMAP IDLE/subscription push remains the #3614 seam.
